item.title: Japan PM Takaichi’s Landslide Election Win Points to Looser Fiscal Policy
item.description: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s emphatic win in Japan’s election points to more expansionary fiscal settings over the coming years, Fitch Ratings says. item.description: The NFIB Small Business Optimism Index in the US fell to 99.3 in January 2026 from 99.5 in December 2025, compared to forecasts of 99.9. item.title: Bauxite offers real positivity for Capesizes
item.description: Bauxite continues to climb, with a positive downstream outlook, capesize demand could feel the benefit. Bauxite flows increased by 18% in 2025.
